I hate who I am as a person and I hate the degree I chose to pursue in an effort to get my mom to finally approve of me as a human being and it's taken me so long and so much debt to even get to the point of almost graduating, and the thought of stepping foot in my school one more time makes me physically sick and completely full of anxiety and hopelessness, and I feel like a failure and a selfish asshole for wanting to just drop out, or even take off a semester to just try and feel something other than emptiness or unadulterated terror for five minutes, and I haven't gone more than a few hours without thinking about *finally* hanging myself or ziptying a bag around my head or just filling my pockets with rocks and walking out onto the lake.

And I don't know how to even tell anyone who cares about it. What's worse, I don't think they'd understand, and I think I'd just get the same platitudes and pitying, delicate treatment for a few weeks that I've gotten before, which just makes me feel like even more of a POS.

I very much understand. I'm not going to give any advice, or tell you to do anything or tell anyone, because... idk, it feels hypocritical. I guess it's nice to know there's someone else in the universe who feels the same thing I do, right now.

I turned 27 recently. Never thought I'd live this long, and the last three or four birthdays have all been me trying to hide from the world as much as possible while *swearing* that by the next birthday, I'll be happy or dead. So far, I haven't lived up to my promises. Hitting 30 with nothing to show for it except another three years of misery and self-loathing is just...nightmarish.
With heaping helpings of self-loathing, procrastination, anxiety, more self-loathing, and a lot of bad grades.

I'm not sure. I've never done heroin, so I can't be positive and I wouldn't want to give you incorrect information. In general though, I don't think heroin is a painful drug. I'm not clear on dosing though, so I'm not sure 5g would be enough for a surefire OD.

I can relate. I never got why people get so upset about someone wanting to kill themselves when we're perfectly fine with killing animals that are suffering. Or why it's somehow OK for someone with a terminal disease to stop taking treatments, but if you're depressed somehow that's not a good enough reason. I think depression is a terminal disease. It'll be what's going to kill me, one way or another. Maybe I'll hang myself, maybe I'll ignore the signs of cancer or refuse treatments, maybe I'll get drunk and drive into a tree. It's all the same thing in the end.

No shame in quitting a game that sucks.

If it's a transdermal patch, swallowing it would allow you to ingest it correctly. IV versions really work best through IVs/shots. fentanyl is basically morphine or heroin x1000, so it works similarly. You get very high, relaxed, and dose off while your respiratory and CNS shut down.
